items.q: What is the TestMu AI MCP server?
items.a: It is a Model Context Protocol server that exposes TestMu AI tools to MCP clients, so you can run and triage tests in plain English from your IDE or assistant.

items.q: Which tools does the MCP server include?
items.a: HyperExecute, Automation, SmartUI, Accessibility and Test Manager.
Any client that supports MCP, including Claude, Cursor and VS Code.

items.q: Is the MCP server a separate product?
items.a: No. The TestMu AI MCP Server is included with every TestMu AI account and only consumes the test execution minutes a team already pays for.

items.q: How is this different from the HyperExecute MCP server?
items.a: The HyperExecute MCP server covers that one tool. This server bundles all five TestMu AI tools.
